analysis.title: Market Rhythm, 30 October 2026
key_insights: Market breadth is improving and now resembles the April pattern, while the AI trade keeps chopping. Yesterday's price action confirmed the breadth message, with more stocks reclaiming the 200dma and extending higher.
The S&P 500 Equal Weighted ETF (RSP) keeps re-accelerating near prior highs as the AI trade fails to respond to oversold conditions. The desk calls its ability to stay overbought impressive.
Nasdaq 100 futures are approaching the lowest levels since August after a failed breakout and a weak response from oversold conditions. Disappointing earnings weigh on sentiment.
Nasdaq 100 futures key supports are 28,900-760, with 28,230-050 next if those fail.

The desk compares the Korea, memory and SOX complex to ARKK, which peaked in 2021 ahead of the broader market. Range-bound 20-30% swings are common. The complex is oversold for a bounce, but yesterday's tape questions that.
The Magnificent 7 ETF broke below its 50dma yesterday on a soft candle. First support is 68.5, followed by 66.7 (the 200dma). Premarket levels are marginally lower.
The Swiss Market Index (SMI) closed at a record after a week-long range, clearing its prior peak. After a steep two-week rise and stretched momentum, a near-term pause would be technically healthy.
Taiwan TAIEX broke below its 50dma, gapping lower at the open and closing weaker. RSI is not oversold, so there is room lower, with first support near 44,450 and then the 200dma.

Silver (XAGUSD, 52.50) broke below 53.30 support, confirming negative momentum and opening room toward a 51.00 target. A weekly close under 53.30 and below the 100wma would reinforce the bearish message.
USDCHF (0.8250) failed at 0.8300 resistance and printed a lower high. That cap limits upside and leaves room for a drift toward 0.8230-0.8200 support.
earnings_insights: Disappointing earnings are weighing on sentiment in Nasdaq 100 futures. The report names no company and gives no figures.
risk_factors: The AI trade is not bouncing from oversold conditions, and Nasdaq 100 futures could break the 28,900-760 support zone.
The Magnificent 7 ETF is below its 50dma, with premarket levels marginally lower.
Yesterday's tape questions whether the oversold Korea, memory and SOX complex bounces.
SMI is stretched after a steep two-week rise, so a pause is likely.
TAIEX has room lower since RSI is not oversold.
